content.title: Mets vs. Diamondbacks: How to watch on SNY on April 7, 2026
content.text: The Mets open a three-game series against the Diamondbacks at Citi Field on Tuesday at 4:10 p.m. on SNY.Here's what to know about the game and how to watch...Mets NotesFreddy Peralta gets the start for New York. The right-hander had a strong second start, allowing one run on three hits in 5.1 innings against the Giants in San Francisco while walking two and striking out sevenLuis Robert Jr., who has a .907 OPS, has reached base safely in all eight games he has started this seasonFrancisco Alvarez is off to a hot start, slashing .292/.370/.708 with three home runs in nine gamesMarcus Semien has found his stroke after some early struggles, with seven hits in his last 16 at-batsTobias Myers has been stellar in relief, with a 1.13 ERA and 0.37 WHIP in 8.0 innings across four appearancesToday's LineupsDIAMONDBACKSMETSKetel Marte, 2BFrancisco Lindor, SSCorbin Carroll, RFBo Bichette, 3BGeraldo Perdomo, SSJorge Polanco, DHGabriel Moreno, CLuis Robert Jr., CFAdrian Del Castillo, DHBrett Baty, RFNolan Arendao, 3BMark Vientos, 1BIldemaro Vargas, 1BMarcus Semien, 2BAlek Thomas, CFCarson Benge, LFJorge Barrosa, LFFrancisco Alvarez, CWhat channel is SNY?Check your TV or streaming provider's website or channel finder to find your local listings.How can I stream the game?The way to stream SNY games is via the MLB App or MLB.tv.In order to stream games in SNY’s regional territory, you will need to have SNY as part of your TV package (cable or streaming), or you can now purchase an in-market SNY subscription package via MLB or Amazon. Both ways will allow fans to watch the Mets on their computer, tablet or mobile phone.How can I watch the game on my computer via MLB?To get started on your computer, click here and then follow these steps:Log in using your provider credentials. If you are unsure of your provider credentials, please contact your provider.Link your provider credentials with a new or existing MLB.com account.Log in using your MLB.com credentials to watch Mets games on SNY.Select the SNY Mets game you wish to view from the Multimedia Center.How can I watch the game on the MLB App?MLB App access is included for FREE with SNY. To access SNY on your favorite supported Apple or Android mobile device, please follow the steps below.Download the free MLB App.Open “MLB” and tap on “Subscriber Login” for Apple Devices or “Sign in with MLB.com” for Android Devices.Type in your MLB.com credentials and tap “Log In.” To access live or on-demand content, tap on the "Watch" tab from the bottom navigation bar. Select the "Games" sub-tab to see a listing of available games. You can scroll to previous dates using the left and right arrows. Tap on a game to select from the game feeds available. For more information on how to stream Mets games on SNY, please click here.
